string-array.name: pattern_field_help
string-array.item: The amount debited or credited by this transaction, not the balance. Example: “Amount: 120.00 SAR”
The shop or party you paid. Example: “At: TEST SHOP”
The last four digits of your card as the message shows them, even with stars. Example: “Card: *1234”
The balance left after the transaction; never counted as the amount. Example: “Balance: 900 SAR”
The person or party on the other side of a transfer. Example: “To: Mohammed”
The account the money left, usually its last digits. Example: “From: *3001”
The account the money reached. Example: “To account: *5678”
The other party\'s bank in a transfer. Example: “From Al Rajhi Bank”
Ref or Ref. No.: the bank\'s number for this transaction; it does not identify an account. Example: “Ref. No. 123456”
Who the bill was paid to. Example: “Biller: STC”
Acc or Ac Ref: your account\'s last digits as the bank writes them, sometimes only three. Example: “Acc: *345”
How money was added, such as a card or another account. Example: “Via: *6789”
The SADAD biller number. Example: “Biller code: 001”
What is due on a card or financing; never counted as the transaction amount. Example: “Due amount: 1,000 SAR”
Extra fee for transactions outside Saudi Arabia. Example: “Intl fee: 2.50 SAR”
The transaction amount in a non-SAR currency before conversion. Example: “USD 20.00”
